instructions.title: Configure PostgreSQL
instructions.summary: Provide the SensorNetwork PostgreSQL connection string and apply the application migrations.
steps: Create a dedicated database and least-privilege application account.
Set ConnectionStrings:SensorNetwork using the deployment configuration mechanism.
Apply the Aegis.SensorNetwork EF Core migrations.

instructions.title: Provision API administration credential
instructions.summary: Create the administration credential in the configured Common.Secrets provider.
steps: Store it as SensorNetwork:Api:AdminKey through Common.Secrets.
Do not place the secret value in commissioning notes or reports.
Verify that the workload identity can resolve the secret.

instructions.title: Verify diagnostics
instructions.summary: Expose and configure the SensorNetwork diagnostics endpoint.
steps: Configure Applications:SensorNetwork:DiagnosticsUrl with its health/diagnostic endpoint.
Run verification and confirm the endpoint responds successfully.
